subject: P09
required_fixes: R1 — API Client mutation reviews escape the integrated renderer-retirement boundary. apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:133 calls AuthorityHandle::retire_renderer on main-page reload, but crates/desktop-core/src/authority/change_domain.rs:909 retires only change-domain reviews and disclosures, leaving workbench.sending.review intact. Meanwhile authority/workbench_domain/send.rs:929 uses confirm without revocable ownership; NativeConfirmation::confirm supplies an independently live default lease (native_confirmation.rs:264). Consequently, an API Client Apply awaiting native confirmation can survive a renderer reload and, if accepted with unchanged context/files/credentials, pass check_review and dispatch the mutation. Context retirement or dismissReview removes the review but also leaves its queued/shown native sheet unowned. This defeats the lifecycle guarantee implemented for Administration and Harness. Acceptance: bind API Client review/confirmation presentation to revocable native ownership; retire it on renderer teardown, review dismissal/replacement, collection departure and context retirement; suppress queued stale sheets and reject late acceptance while preserving outcomes of requests already dispatched. Add production Host/IPC regressions covering both queued and shown confirmations, zero writes after retirement, and successful explicit fresh-page review.
evidence_gaps: E1 — The retained renderer_review_lifecycle tests cover change-domain confirmations and disclosures; the Harness regressions cover conversation retirement. Neither those tests nor the C41 native driver exercise an API Client mutation confirmation across main-page teardown. Passing these separate suites therefore does not establish the combined lifecycle property in R1. Retain a causal regression for that production path and its passing remediation evidence.
